system.description:
Favoured weapon: Pick, Heavy

Granted power: Advantage on Intimidation. Choose acid, cold, fire, lightning or poison at 1st level: you have Resistance 5 to it. Once/day: exhale a 15ft cone of that type (2d6, Reflex save for half).

Allegiance: Lawful Evil, the god's alignment, held while the god favours you. Tenets: on Tiamat in the World of Arneyan wiki.
